selection_rule: Checkpoint uses validation RMSE; neighbor k/gamma and fusion use validation labels only; retain every planned seed and fold
strict_identity: RDKit canonical isomeric SMILES; retain salt/charge/tautomer state; KFold over sorted identities, outer seed=0; 10% remaining identities for validation, inner_seed+fold

statistics.bootstrap_unit: canonical chemical identity sampled within each outer test fold
statistics.primary_estimand: unweighted mean of five test-fold MSE differences
statistics.interval: percentile 95%; fixed predictions only, not training uncertainty
statistics.linear_stacking: unregularized least squares with intercept fitted on validation predictions only; unconstrained coefficients
